speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I understand you are experiencing fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise while pregnant. To help me determine the cause, have you noticed any rash, eye pain, or sensitivity to bright light recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation. The patient presents with a sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. She reports the consumption of ice cream 3 days prior to the onset of symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details. The onset of your symptoms three days after consuming ice cream, along with fever and headache, raises concern for a specific parasitic infection. Have you traveled to or recently visited any areas where tap water or untreated milk might be consumed?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fever. I also have Headache, Anorexia, Fatigue, Malaise.
